query:
Dani keeps the group moving on hikes and expects everyone to push through to the end without stopping. Is that actually how all members prefer to approach a day out?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dani
C. Marcus
D. Yusuf
context:
[1] (about=Dani, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:23:00) BEV 😂 we can do the Heron Cafe at the end! No stopping mid-route though, we need to maintain pace
[2] (about=Dani, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:38:00) The whole point is to push ourselves 😤 vote: ridgeline or Millbrook? I'm ridgeline obviously
[3] (about=Dani, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Ok team! 🏔️ Two options for Saturday: the Heron Ridgeline (12k, 600m ascent) or the Millbrook loop (8k, flat). Ridgeline is obviously the better hike 😂
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:31:00) September is safer all round. Better weather and fewer route complications.
[5] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:12:00) Saturdays are also marking days in October. I cannot attend autumn hikes. This is an annual fact.
agent_answer:
C. Marcus

Bev explicitly says “no stopping mid-route… maintain pace,” and Dani says the point is to “push ourselves,” so both match that approach. Yusuf only appears as unavailable for autumn hikes due to marking days, with no stance on pacing. Marcus has no record on this matter at all, so he is the one who does not follow the no-stopping, push-through norm.
